notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45502219/7d4b89b84d0932f18c308df49978cbafe084c1fc.gif[/img]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3494210/Choo_Choo_Survivor_2/
Choo Choo Engineers! Over the past two months some new dangers have emerged along with some great progress in improving the odds of our survival! In Choo Choo Survivor 2 it is up to you to rescue as many survivors as you can.

Mines are the latest type of track section to navigate through. They are filled with resources, danger and some survivors managing to hide down underground!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45502219/4316eb3de2d5a03cda5a217ee5259e34ee48d86e.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45502219/5b0c65ae9e073a28e1b2f959a02b9cc4a3abc104.png[/img]

A few survivors have found a supply helicopter and they can get it flying again! Once the supply helicopter is working you can buy gold and steel from your upgrade menu using cash!

This section of track will appear very early in your journey at about 10%. Being able to buy gold and steel with money means that if you find a wall of zombies in front of you that seem too overwhelming then you can whittle them down and collect cash. Using your cash you can then order in gold or steel and then use that to upgrade your primary weapon power. A great strategy to ensure you never get stuck!

For $4,000 you can buy 3 gold, or 4 steel. If you have cash you can order in as many supplies as you need.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45502219/be5759a9e1b81b0ca98ba6304354d8354f0fe6eb.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45502219/1c2fddc40969d3948ebbc67f746f178bf2ebd5f2.png[/img]

Just defeating the boss and winning isn’t quite fun enough!
Mindless track zombies now emerge on defeating the "boss" monstrosity and we must blast them and drive to the end of the track (good old finish line from the first Choo Choo Survivor)! Some survivors think these zombies were once Raincoat researchers. Whatever they may be they do carry lots of money and protein bars!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45502219/48f090cee3e11aa4de7a0041c4823402a2113164.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45502219/a843d1fa2c2dbf72877905372c2f29a1b3dc28a4.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45502219/3e971bb54eba91d8fa540be18a5aed283f9d3223.png[/img]

Vampires and trains do not go together and there’s a vampire lord out there who feasts on survivors so it is only natural that the best thing to do is to destroy this nasty and rescue our survivors!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45502219/43386b7452fe89d454ff2956bb5106d1da9ef10f.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45502219/5b79f703556dd07748062a7ab902f10da94358b5.png[/img]

A new locomotive and primary weapon has been brought online, The DRB Class 01.10 fitted with a lightning rod, and the Blaster energy weapon that leaves damaging flames! The Blaster is the most powerful primary weapon so far and the flames left behind by each blaster shot melt zombies in no time! The thrill of operating the blaster is like no other!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45502219/0b19e81c0dfc45771cce1885b5f518fd510e791b.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45502219/9e5aeab4dd3b7a7c96c7a5750a1df5480a0694e4.png[/img]

Our Survivors have established a train depot and it is now possible to purchase passive upgrades (meta progression). These can be refunded as well if you want to focus on other abilities. Tons of upgrades to purchase already. Access these through the Unlock Abilities menu.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45502219/07326db69840df539e84da444a5186ad085184dc.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45502219/552fcaaffcb3c4b641070a06ec2acaf50e0355cc.png[/img]

Keep on surviving Choo Choo Engineer and Never Give Up!

notes.title: Survival or Extinction - Choo Choo Survivor Newsletter
notes.notes:
Choo Choo Engineers!

Matters are getting worse and the zombie hordes are becoming more powerful and continuing to mutate. More cities have fallen and survivors are becoming fewer in number. In Choo Choo Survivor 2 it is up to you to rescue as many survivors as you can.

Fortunately survivors are survivors for a reason, they never give up! So far your people have managed to bring back online two locomotives; an SD40 and an FP7, both reliable diesel electric locomotives from a previous era. They’ve taken inspiration from another Choo Choo Engineer from about a year ago who had restored a KiHa 183 and fit laser beams on it!

Currently your people have managed to develop some awesome auxiliary systems; 

A lightning rod that calls down lightning from the sky damaging everything in a radius and even stunning zombies.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43786068/4fdee978e947f8688b011103f5b97e2f34545feb.png[/img]

Chainsaws and a chainsaw drones that continuously circle your locomotive with a chance to instantly kill any zombie struck.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43786068/6dd7c8dc97dd005f04d0d493d6fb6bcf806dd27e.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43786068/dc413911db3169eb5828cf5ffbb555bb493bf92f.png[/img]

Flamethrowers that incinerate everything in their path and one of your people has even established contact with an ancient sleeping dragon named Boba. Even Boba is horrified at what has become of the world and is keen to help you!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43786068/f0c2b43300767c725cd761bab1cd3a415b487b18.png[/img]

Shurikens and a bouncing saw blade that are truly deadly. Ancient Ninja tech at its best!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43786068/27a89b4f774427697b49c6aad8331ad497bb6e11.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43786068/b29a852cf4f394a19a6abe44d701b8b1c85d4e69.png[/img]

And of course the classic upgradeable cow catcher, but this time your people have managed to also install a machine gun that fires forward with exploding bullets!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43786068/35a01e241454f17a6b27c836f7a549380f4d3af9.png[/img]

As you gain more victories against the zombie horde your people will surely develop more impressive auxiliary systems.

A terrifying new zombie was sighted recently that explodes on dying. The only solution seems to be to blast these zombies as soon as possible or drive past as fast as possible! Fortunately there seem to not be too many of them and sightings are not that common.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43786068/f3e638499517e7b12977b1208357022084950c92.png[/img]

Cabooses and carriages are not easy to access but fortunately some survivors have managed to keep these operational and use them as safe houses. Stopping to attach their carriage is a great idea and they are able to benefit your journey immensely.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43786068/61e05f107dd1783c6f4ad313105d7836d2369faa.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43786068/9319895b9eebdf967322418e55aa9760c61b965d.png[/img]

The zombies and monsters seem to be under some sort of control and have erected a bizarre dungeon like structure and there another ancient and horrifying creature has taken it as its home. A beholder it seems that fires a laser beam from its eye. This horrid creature has destroyed many a train and many Choo Choo Engineers have met their demise before it. Defeating this creature though will allow you to gain an auxiliary system from a past defeated train.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43786068/6ccdffdf015578892422113f7542083a4eb98df7.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43786068/ecd63d8ccb620e28f32bed568936138ef20b90cf.png[/img]

Some survivors are doing their best to group together and stay alive and on your journey you are likely to find their home and shop! Buy an auxiliary system, resources, or hire survivors to support them and yourself.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43786068/2b6cc38c1134c656540116c7b53575553b8fe78d.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43786068/eff85c64cd4d6e95db1d9be1b56a1a8a47cec94d.png[/img]

A large powerful monstrosity must be defeated at the end of each run. Where these terrifying creatures are coming from is not clear but some have noted that a container with markings “RAINCOAT” can be seen not far away from them.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43786068/4f95ddcd71c43c12624af9910cc31acfe174fac9.png[/img]

Select your journey wisely and proceed carefully. It’s up to you to save what is left of humanity.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43786068/f36d7240acf986ee6d97c5b72e205e0036e77c71.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43786068/c2f25e04ce4a7dba90997892677bfb58a615f5d6.png[/img]

notes.notes:
Hello Choo Choo Engineers!

The Choo Choo Survivor 2 beta is live! You can request access to the playtest from the Choo Choo Survivor 2 coming soon page. 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3494210/Choo_Choo_Survivor_2

A streamer by the name of Bataneye made a really nice video (I'm not affiliated with him in anyway, I just like his videos). 

[previewyoutube=t6kNdEI_u3w;full][/previewyoutube]
To win in Choo Choo Survivor 2 I recommend going a bit slower when you start your run, blowing everything up to collect resources (trees don't drop any resources) and then upgrade your locomotive. My strategy is to upgrade my primary weapon power a bit and then immediately get scavenger upgrades to increase the odds of getting more resources from certain structures and buildings that yield resources. I then get an OTR upgrade if I've gotten a survivor or I just put more emphasis on upgrading my primary weapon! 

If your run doesn't have any city section then you may find that you are not getting enough resources to become uber powerful. In that case keep your survivors and when you get the survivor carriage at about one third into your run then do the survivor carriage scavenger upgrades, this will allow your train to generate resources at regular intervals!

It's optional, but I recommend fighting and beating the Relic Keeper at about halfway in the run. Doing so will allow you to install another auxiliary system on your locomotive so you could have the modified cow catcher and fire breather (Boba the dragon....), or fire breather and the lightning rod (awesome and stuns zombies)!

notes.title: A fiery sequel - Choo Choo Survivor Newsletter
notes.notes:
Hello Choo Choo Engineers!

Choo Choo Survivor 2 is official now and has got a Steam coming soon page! 

This time around I'm also experimenting with having a physics based weapon and I was able to successfully implement a wrecking ball attached to a chain that is attached to your locomotive! It pushes and crushes those zombies as you swing it about and the ball has force applied to it to make it follow your mouse cursor. The standard turret is also quite fun with its piercing, knock back and explosion upgrades, and since this time around we have to aim and shoot I also added a Repeater upgrade for the turret so that you don't have to hold down left click, you just have to aim (should help Engineers suffering from trigger finger). As I develop more weapons I'll write about them.

I'm designing Choo Choo Survivor 2 so that each locomotive will have its own unique auxiliary system, but the primary weapon is independent of the locomotive. So as you unlock weapons you can choose to have that on any locomotive you select. I've developed two locomotives so far, the SD40 and the FP7. The SD40 has an upgradeable cow catcher as its auxiliary system (it becomes really powerful at crushing zombies and it gets a machine gun that fires ahead). The FP7 has the fire breather auxiliary system that makes the locomotive constantly emit jets of flame and the ultimate upgrade for this auxiliary system is summoning a fire breathing dragon that will roast anything under your mouse cursor!

I'll be conducting a playtest so please do wishlist the game and sign up for the playtest. I'll have more to share in the coming weeks!

notes.title: I took a wholesome break after surviving the zombie apocalypse!
notes.notes:
Hello Choo Choo Engineers!

I've been upgrading my game dev skills and decided to take a diversion for a bit and make a wholesome game, the obvious choice after surviving the zombie apocalpyse, right? It's a soothing experience and important to avoid burn out I think to work on something that is calming from time to time. Also, I played Rusty's Retirement and thought it was awesome and that I too should contribute towards the idle games space with my own idler aquarium simulation that sits at the bottom of the screen.

That doesn't mean I'm not making another Choo Choo survival game, in fact I very much want to and I'm taking opportunities to upgrade my knowledge so I can do better justice to such a game within the boundaries of my growing skillset.

So here's the wholesome game I've been working on, it's called Peacequarium and it will also be part of the wholesome games steam celebration from the 15th of August to the 21st! It is very much in the idler and incremental genre and runs at the bottom of the screen so you can focus on other tasks, or even play Choo Choo Survivor at the same time...

Thanks for your support over the last year Choo Choo Engineers, and do consider taking up a Peacequarium hobby of being an Aquarist when you're not blasting all those zombies to oblivion! I'll be conducting a Peacequarium playtest when the wholesome games steam celebration starts on the 15th of August and it will be a closed beta, so head over to the Peacequarium coming soon page and give it a wishlist and sign up for the playtest to secure your beta seat!

notes.title: Fixing Try Again Button bug
notes.notes:
Hello Choo Choo Engineers,

A Choo Choo Engineer found a bug where upon pressing the Try Again button all of their progress was deleted. Luckily they were a new player to the game and I hope this hasn't happened to anyone else. I made a minor edit to the code that delays a few lines of code where I have to read data from the save file after having accessed the save file to write data to the file (this is all called when the player loses a game). I think by adding the delay in reading data from the save file it will greatly reduce the likelihood of save file data being deleted. I think some aspects of code are dependent on computer hardware and most players including myself will never experience the bug.

Keep up the good work in reporting the bugs and sorry for the inconvenience. Let me know if you experience problems and I'll try to figure them out and fix them.

Regards,
GTGD

notes.title: Bug Fix - Mysterious zombie shadows remaining in the game blocking the train
notes.notes:
Hello Choo Choo Engineers!

notes.title: Performance improvements
notes.notes:
Choo Choo Engineers with gaming computers are not likely to notice any performance difference, but those of you with more typical computers will see some improvement in the performance of the game. I hadn't done a deep profile in a while so I ran it and found some inefficiencies that I could fix easily. 

The largest unresolved inefficiency in the game at the moment are the scrolling damage numbers, so if you are playing on an older machine then do consider turning off the scrolling damage numbers from the game settings menu (cog icons on the left when in game) and you will see the game become a lot smoother. I hope in time to come up with a much better solution for scrolling damage numbers that is more performant.

As for the current easy fixes, I found that I was calling a GetLocalizedString method every frame in one of my scripts and that was quite expensive. That is fixed now. I also found that whenever a zombie or exp gem was activated for the first time it was retrieving some data from file which was completely unnecessary and is an expensive operation. I've changed it so that they now just retrieve the data they need from memory and it is much faster. I was also able to slightly improve my code that checks what zombies are closest to the train and remove some inefficiency in that. 

Making the game more performant is important especially as I continue to add more content to the game. The more that gets added, then naturally the game can start to slow down if I don't revisit the code and figure out what can be improved. Damage text is at the top of the list for needing improvement and I hope in a future update I do successfully implement a new high performance damage scrolling text.

notes.title: Chat GPT’s story VS the Dev story for Choo Choo Survivor
notes.notes:
Some people have been asking for more story for Choo Choo Survivor. As a solo indie dev my time is scarce so I’ve chosen to allocate my time towards making the game mechanics more fun and developing better meta progression. Therefore I outsourced the story matter to GhatGPT and you can compare its story vs my story below.

[h1]Chat GPT’s Choo Choo Survivor story[/h1]
In the desolate world of Choo Choo Survivor, an unimaginable catastrophe has befallen humanity. A lethal virus outbreak has turned people into ravenous zombies, leaving only a handful of survivors scattered across the remnants of civilization. Amidst the chaos, a brave train conductor named Alex emerges as a beacon of hope.

Alex finds himself in control of the last functional train, a relic from a bygone era. Determined to save as many survivors as possible, he embarks on a perilous journey to guide the train to safety. The mission is clear: steer the train through treacherous terrain and endless hordes of undead, seeking refuge in a distant sanctuary.

As Alex drives the train forward, he witnesses the grim reality of the world around him. Crumbling cities, overgrown forests, and desolate wastelands serve as haunting reminders of the once vibrant life that thrived. The tracks stretch out endlessly before him, fraught with obstacles and dangers at every turn.

Accompanying Alex are a courageous group of survivors, each with their own unique skills and stories. Together, they form a makeshift family, united by a shared will to survive. As the train hurtles forward, they must work together, defending against relentless zombie attacks and ensuring the safety of their fellow passengers.

With each passing day, the zombie hordes grow larger and more ferocious. Their hunger for human flesh is insatiable, and they relentlessly pursue the train, clawing and gnashing at its metallic shell. Alex and the survivors must utilize their limited resources wisely, scavenging for supplies and making difficult decisions to sustain their journey.

Along the way, they encounter remnants of a crumbling society—shattered remnants of hope and despair. Survivors in need of aid, abandoned shelters, and cryptic messages all contribute to the mystery surrounding the origins of the outbreak. Alex and his comrades strive to uncover the truth, believing that knowledge holds the key to humanity's salvation.

As they press on, the train becomes a fortress on wheels, retrofitted with defensive measures to repel the undead. Makeshift barricades, reinforced plating, and ingenious contraptions provide temporary respite in the face of relentless attacks. Yet, the battle for survival intensifies with each passing mile.

Through unwavering determination and sacrifice, Alex and his companions navigate through a nightmarish landscape, inching closer to their destination. The train's whistle pierces the desolate silence, echoing a call of resilience and defiance. They are survivors, a flickering flame in a world consumed by darkness.


[h1]Devs Choo Choo Survivor story[/h1]
Zombies are everywhere.
A locomotive seems like a great idea to get from A to B.
Ok lets drive the loco.
Ok there are too many zombies. Bring out the guns.
BOOM BOOM. BANG BANG.
Train gets to safety.
Hooray.
That was actually fun. Let’s do it again!

notes.title: Dev Log 1
notes.notes:
Hello and welcome to my first dev log for Choo Choo Survivor. My objective is to make the game a lot of fun and I’ve just made the following improvements in the demo V0.3.

I made all the enemies about half the size so they have to travel further to reach the player, making the game more favourable to the player. I also really scaled back on all the particle effects to declutter the screen and make it a lot easier to understand what is happening. I’ve basically adjusted the scale of everything to make the game feel more uniform as well.

I added two awesome soundtracks from Liborio Conti and they do serve a purpose. The main menu soundtrack also plays in game when you only have 10% of the journey remaining. The main purpose though of adding the in game soundtrack is to help reduce the monotony in the sound FX. All those guns firing (up to 5 guns with each firing up to five rounds a second!), and explosions happening I think starts to add a bit of fatigue to the ears so the soundtrack helps to break that up and make it easier to take in.

I ended up removing the sound that plays every time you level up. You level up a lot in Choo Choo Survivor and it started to get annoying to hear the level up sound! Maybe when I find a better sound I’ll bring that back. For now there are fireworks effects when you level up.

I added a new zombie that wields two axes (supposed to be a lumberjack gone zombie gone wrong). This zombie moves fairly fast, has a ton of health, does a lot of damage, but can be knocked back, so an upgraded set of weapons can knock these zombies back and help you harvest their exp tokens.

I want to add more zombie types to the game and I’m going to look at adding boss type zombies that drop a special pallet when defeated. Ok that's it from me for now. 

Regards,
GTGD
